unexecuted_external_dependencies: Real SMTP, end-recipient delivery, authenticated bounces and HTTPS RFC8058 mail-client integration
Production TLS/load, multisite and other browsers/physical devices
historical_failures: Initial onboarding harness invoked erasure extension without complete native lifecycle; corrected to actual native deletion, then full confirmed eraser independently tested.
Initial help test expected a request-local Catalog instance to invalidate across an admin archive; corrected to fresh next-request public projection.

Initial campaign selector expected obsolete ORDER BY CASE, and HTTP local mail expectation incorrectly required HTTPS-only RFC8058 header; corrected selectors and actual unsent digest regressions executed.
Initial pause test expected retry; actual paused known-unsent contract returns queued without consuming attempts; corrected and reexecuted.
Actual P1 native privacy erasure failed because a later module required an earlier module marker after its removal; fixed with identity-bound erasure context, real native regression passed.
Actual P2 native Help/Subscriptions admin headers were emitted after HTML; fixed at load hook and real browser regression passed.
Initial browser submission selector selected logout form; corrected harness and real owned draft flow reexecuted.
